enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, showering, and getting ready
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Put on clothes.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out food. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Turn on induction cooker. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off sleepwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to office. Clock in. Put on uniform.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Clock in. Change into scrubs. Attend handover meeting. Receive patient list. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Wash hands. Check vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Adjust IV. Walk to next patient.
Walk to bus stop. Check phone. Board bus. Find seat. Sit. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Take off shoes. Hang up coat.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pan. Close cupboard. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add ingredients. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put feet on coffee table. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV.

Enter kitchen. Clear table. Scrape food from plates into trash. Stack plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load utensils. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Rinse cloth. Wipe counters. Turn off light.
Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Type password. Open browser. Check email. Read news. Click links. Scroll. Open document. Type text. Save document. Close browser. Close laptop. Stand up.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Wash face. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, watching TV or reading
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on TV. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Close book. Put book down.
